episodes.title: This is the Beginning of the End
episodes.summary: Ulysses Zane is struggling in the dating scene in LA. His best friend, Carly, is striving to become an actress. Uly's roommate, Ford, is an aspiring screenwriter dating Severine, an astrobiological theorist.

episodes.title: Where is My Mind?
episodes.summary: Ulysses researches information about alien reptile conspiracies and gets ghosted by Gabriel. Ford catches his big break as a screenwriter. Carly attends acting class. Severine and Ford explore non-monogamy.

episodes.title: The Rules of Attraction
episodes.summary: Severine reconnects with her ex-lover Mustafa. Famous director Otto West convinces Ford to do a risqué photo shoot. Uly is haunted by Gabriel. Carly partakes in a private lesson from her acting teacher, Frank.

episodes.title: The Downward Spiral
episodes.summary: Ford is torn about his relationship with Severine and drags Uly with him to a men's group, where he discovers how to be more in tune with his feelings. Carly interviews new roommates.

episodes.title: Stranger Than Paradise
episodes.summary: Ford gets invited to a lavish party in Palm Springs and convinces Severine, Ulysses and Carly to come along. Ulysses has an encounter with renowned alien expert Mitchell Kent at a book signing. Carly meets artist Leif.

episodes.title: She's Lost Control
episodes.summary: It's the hottest day of the year. Ulysses helps Carly with her new web series, "Sluts." Ford finds out Severine's true feelings about him. Carly and Jethro explore a new area of their relationship.

episodes.title: Anywhere Out of the World
episodes.summary: Ulysses meets social worker Isaac and falls for him fast. Severine surprises Ford by taking him to an "Eyes Wide Shut" party. Ford discovers that his photo shoot with Otto is on display for the whole world.

episodes.title: Unknown Pleasures
episodes.summary: Carly takes Jethro to a BDSM sex dungeon. Severine wants Ford to make her sexual dreams come true. Uly and Isaac have an amazing first date. Ford feels ambivalent about his non-monogamous relationship with Severine.

episodes.title: Disappear Here
episodes.summary: Severine has to go on a business trip to Roswell for an indefinite period, and Ford is devastated. Uly's relationship with Isaac intensifies. Carly runs into Leif, the artist she flirted with in Palm Springs.

episodes.title: Everything is Gone Forever
episodes.summary: Uly and Isaac's relationship disintegrates when Isaac learns about Gabriel. Carly fights with Jethro about her camming. Ford wants to know where he and Severine stand. Carly gets a big career break.
